source.title: Executive Assistants Leader Announcement (August 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce that we have a new Team Leader. Lisa Kucala will become the new Leader of the WCA Executive Assistants Team (WEAT).

<!-- break -->

Lisa was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our [Motion about WCA Committees and Teams](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf). This appointment is effective as of 5th August 2025.

Lisa will be WCA's first Executive Assistant Team Leader and we wish her all the best as she takes on her new responsibilities.

Lisa was the only applicant for the role, and her successful candidacy document can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_fKrPHEjFONa4kKbh4KH5N4panIdPSPa/view).

translation.title: 董事会助理团队负责人任命公告（2025 年 8 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴地宣布，Lisa Kucala 将出任 WCA 董事会助理团队（WEAT）的新任负责人。

WCA 董事会依照[《关于 WCA 委员会与团队的议案》](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 5 节的规定，选出 Lisa 并投票通过了这一任命。任命自 2025 年 8 月 5 日起生效。

Lisa 将成为 WCA 首位董事会助理团队负责人。祝她在新的岗位上一切顺利。

Lisa 是这一职位的唯一申请人，其申请材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_fKrPHEjFONa4kKbh4KH5N4panIdPSPa/view)查看。
